author: Ginsburg, 1933

note.en: A 10 cm flounder of the outer shelf at about 15 to 180 m, known here only from Bussing & López's guide and from trawl specimens off Caribbean Panama.
note.es: Un lenguado de 10 cm de la plataforma externa, a unos 15 a 180 m, conocido aquí solo por la guía de Bussing y López y por ejemplares de arrastre frente al Caribe de Panamá.

evidence: Added: not in the original species list
Listed for Costa Rica's Caribbean coast by Bussing & López (2010)
Trawl specimens off Caribbean Panama at 15 to 95 m (Florida Museum, Smithsonian, 1965 to 1966)

sources.t: Bussing & López 2010, Peces costeros del Caribe de Centroamérica meridional, Rev. Biol. Trop. 58 (Suppl. 2): 188-189 (Bothidae)

recWhy: Listed for Caribbean Costa Rica by Bussing & López; specimens off Caribbean Panama.

marks.en: Small flatfish with both eyes on one side and a spiny rough surface; brown with darker blotches.
marks.es: Lenguado pequeño con ambos ojos en un lado y superficie áspera; pardo con manchas más oscuras.
